understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and game to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) when possible. Adjacent blocks could be pushed, while walls or boundaries could block movement, though the blocked hint was only heuristic and actions sometimes needed to be tested. CLICK was used to select another piece, using its exact pixel/grid position, but clicking an incorrect or inaccessible position did not change selection. Each action consumed a limited step, including unsuccessful moves and clicks.
